visual.name: pnlByDatenWG
visual.description: IBCS-inspired P&L / GuV statement: unbalanced parent-child account hierarchy or level columns, subtotal and formula rows (EBITDA, margins), sign conventions with variance-invert for cost rows, scenarios AC/PY/PL/FC with delta bars and delta-percent pins, k/m scaling and a 3-line IBCS title block. Views: table with the IBCS mega table (templates T01–T04 and 12A: value and variance columns, bars, pins, integrated variance waterfalls, value cascades, month | YTD blocks, thresholds), structure bars, row waterfall and a value driver tree (DuPont or dimension hierarchy) with card zoom, re-root and breadcrumb. Selection, cross-filtering, drillthrough and the native context menu. Smart Start demo statement while no fields are bound, light / dark appearance that follows the report theme, and a localized UI in German, English, Spanish and Japanese.
